It’s the default. Conventional platforms lock you out, leaving you with no way to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-my-unfiltered-take|COREMERCH guide to payment]]. This guide solves that. It walks you through deploying [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-8|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure that lets you sell globally, get paid in USDT, and deliver products instantly—without depending on any third party. No workarounds. No subscriptions. You own the stack. It’s built on GitHub Pages, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-9|cloudflare]] Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments—tools that don’t care where you’re located. By the end of this guide, you’ll have a fully operational store that processes crypto payments, verifies transactions on-chain, and delivers files automatically. This isn’t a hack. It’s infrastructure.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal operate on permission. They decide who can participate based on geography, politics, or whim. This infrastructure operates on ownership. You deploy it. You control it. It’s built on open tools that don’t discriminate. GitHub Pages hosts your store for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders without monthly fees. NOWPayments verifies USDT payments on-chain for a flat 0.5% fee. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. The stack is designed to bypass financial gatekeepers. USDT on Tron or Solana settles in seconds for under $0.10 per transaction. File delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2—no bandwidth limits. This isn’t a workaround for a broken system. It’s a replacement. You’re not renting access. You’re building sovereignty.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather three things. First, a NOWPayments account. Sign up at nowpayments.io. It’s free, requires no KYC, and supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Second, a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting. Both are free. Third, your digital product files. Organize them in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You’ll need basic familiarity with GitHub or Cloudflare dashboards—no coding required. If you’re deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, you’ll also need a domain for email configuration (SPF/DKIM/DMARC). For the Sovereign Starter Stack, a free GitHub Pages URL works. Ensure your product descriptions and pricing are finalized. Decide which USDT network you’ll accept—Tron and Solana are recommended for low fees. If you’re in Pakistan, factor in P2P conversion rates when pricing. This infrastructure doesn’t handle local currency conversion. It handles global payment acceptance. You’ll convert USDT to PKR via local exchanges or peers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payment verification. In NOWPayments, create a USDT payment link. Set the webhook URL to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. This fires the moment payment confirms on-chain. Next, configure file delivery. Upload your product to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Generate a shareable link. In your backend logic, write a script that sends this link to the buyer’s email after payment verification. Use Cloudflare Workers for serverless execution or Google Apps Script for simplicity. For order storage, set up a Supabase table or Google Sheet. Log each transaction with buyer email, product purchased, and payment ID. Test the pipeline manually. Send a test payment. Ensure the webhook triggers file delivery and logs the order. This pipeline is your core commerce engine. It runs 24/7 without your intervention.
USDT on Tron settles in 15 seconds for $0.01. Solana is even faster.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Push your frontend code to the repository. GitHub Pages will serve it automatically. For Cloudflare Pages, connect your repository and deploy with one click. Share your store URL with your audience. When the first payment comes in, NOWPayments will verify it on-chain. The webhook will trigger your backend logic. The buyer gets their file. The order is logged. You’re notified via email. Monitor the transaction in your Supabase dashboard or Google Sheet. For P2P conversion in Pakistan, use local exchanges like LocalBitcoins or Binance P2P. Convert USDT to PKR at market rates. This step is manual but necessary. Your infrastructure handles global payments. You handle local conversion. The system is now live. It processes transactions without your involvement. You focus on creating. The stack handles commerce.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live, scale methodically. Add more products by updating your backend logic. Each product gets a unique file link and price. Monitor transaction volume in NOWPayments and Supabase. If orders increase, optimize your pipeline. Upgrade to Cloudflare Workers for faster execution. Use Supabase’s scaling features for high-volume order storage. For email deliverability, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC if you haven’t already. This ensures file delivery emails don’t land in spam. If you’re selling in multiple regions, localize pricing in USDT. Use Tron or Solana for low-fee transactions. For P2P conversion in Pakistan, establish relationships with reliable traders. Automate what you can. Manual steps like local conversion are unavoidable but manageable. This infrastructure scales with you. It’s not a temporary fix. It’s your commerce backbone.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To get paid in USDT for digital work in Pakistan, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. Use USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Convert USDT to PKR via local P2P exchanges. This infrastructure bypasses Stripe and PayPal restrictions, giving you full control over your commerce pipeline.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is the lowest in crypto commerce.

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Sign up for NOWPayments and create a USDT payment link.
2. Host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
3. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
4. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets.
5. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
6. Configure webhook to trigger file delivery after payment.
7. Test the pipeline with a dummy transaction.
8. Deploy your store and share the URL.
9. Monitor transactions in Supabase or Google Sheets.
10. Convert USDT to PKR via local P2P exchanges.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack requires no coding. Use GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Follow the blueprint step-by-step. The Edge Commerce Stack requires basic Cloudflare dashboard familiarity. Both stacks are designed for non-developers.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it fails, payments pause until it’s back online. Your store remains accessible. Transactions resume automatically. No data is lost. This is rare but possible with any service.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?

Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once USDT is sent, it cannot be charged back. This protects you from fraud. Ensure your product descriptions are clear to avoid disputes. Crypto’s finality is a feature, not a bug.
Can I accept local currency instead of USDT?

This infrastructure is designed for USDT payments. To accept local currency, integrate a separate gateway. However, USDT is widely convertible in Pakistan via P2P exchanges. It’s the more sovereign option.
What if I need to refund a customer?

Manually send USDT back to the customer’s wallet. Record the refund in your Supabase or Google Sheet. Communicate the refund via email. This step is manual but straightforward. Refunds are rare with digital products.
You own the stack. No platform can shut you down.
